answer: Because the pearl pair is tracked in the tide ledger, the ripple audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 38 identities means 38 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 25%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
